node-1.label: A young woman in her mid-to-late teens presented with a 3-month history of protruding eyes, blurred vision, and chronic frontal headache

node-2.label: History of acute lymphoblastic leukemia diagnosed at age 9, with 2 central nervous system relapses at ages 12 and 16

node-3.label: Physical examination: corrected visual acuity 6/12, pinhole 6/9 in both eyes; Hertel exophthalmometry 25 mm bilaterally on base 105; pupils slightly sluggish without relative afferent defect; both optic discs grossly swollen; intraocular pressure and eye movements normal
